svg.text: Every 10 seconds an act, every minute a beat, every 10 minutes a voyage, across days the ladder and the garden
days: the ladder and the garden
one act with the hands; the world
answers at once (a squeak, the mist
one beat; the leaf changes: it lifts,
the workshops glow, the bud above
one voyage; the real plant changes for
good: it stands, blooms, grows heavy
Size Magic goes deeper each grade
(a cactus, a lily, a pumpkin, a tree);
Inside a leaf the rhythm alternates two jobs: in the cloud, open the doors; in the blaze, close them and carry the sugar.
